sources.название: Classification of chronic pain and spinal cord stimulation response using machine learning in magnetoencephalography data
sources.авторы: Bart Witjes; Martijn P. A. Starmans; Frank J.P.M. Huygen; Cecile C. de Vos
sources.модальность: Resting-state MEG spectral features from 94 atlas regions
sources.задача: Chronic-pain classification and exploratory association with concurrent SCS-session outcomes
sources.метод: WORC ensemble with leave-one-participant-out evaluation and nested 5x random-split model selection
sources.датасет: 25 SCS patients, 25 chronic-pain patients, and 25 pain-free controls; SCS group measured after tonic, burst, and sham weeks
sources.производительность: Chronic-pain versus control accuracy 76%; theta AUC 0.80; SCS-group classifier score versus NRS Spearman rho 0.12
sources.ограничения: MEG classification separates chronic-pain patients from pain-free controls and its scores correlate poorly with pain ratings in the SCS group (rho=0.12). There was no pre-implant baseline in the SCS group and no prospective SCS-responder classifier. MEG spectral features are not ECAP.

sources.название: A Systematic Review of Multimodal Signal Fusion for Acute Pain Assessment Systems
sources.авторы: Muhammad Umar Khan; Girija Chetty; Roland Goecke; Raul Fernandez-Rojas
sources.модальность: Multimodal physiological signals including ECG, EDA, EMG, EEG, PPG and respiration
sources.задача: Systematic review of multimodal fusion for acute experimental-pain assessment
sources.метод: PRISMA-based search of Scopus, IEEE Xplore and Google Scholar in September 2024 with backward/forward snowballing
sources.датасет: 31 studies published from January 2015 through September 2024; 20 used public datasets including BioVid, X-ITE and SenseEmotion
sources.производительность: No pooled effect or common metric; the review tabulates heterogeneous study-specific results
sources.ограничения: Only three bibliographic databases were searched, and image/video-led studies, chronic pain, animal studies and inaccessible papers were excluded by design. The review does not pool metrics or prove that multimodal fusion generalizes across participants or clinical settings.

provenance.query_or_seed: A Systematic Review of Multimodal Signal Fusion for Acute Pain Assessment Systems

evidence.population: 31 acute-pain multimodal studies, predominantly controlled experimental datasets
evidence.target_label: Study-specific acute-pain detection or intensity targets

validation.notes: Only three bibliographic databases were searched, and image/video-led studies, chronic pain, animal studies and inaccessible papers were excluded by design. The review does not pool metrics or prove that multimodal fusion generalizes across participants or clinical settings.

sources.название: Explainable AI for pain perception: subject-independent EEG decoding using DeepSHAP and CNNs
sources.авторы: Feyzi Alkım Aktaş; Aykut Eken; Osman Eroğul
sources.модальность: Laser-evoked 65-channel EEG; parietal 20-frequency by 251-time-point masked time-frequency matrices after preprocessing
sources.задача: Classify individually calibrated low versus high acute laser-stimulus intensity in healthy adults during the motor condition
sources.метод: Five-layer 1D-CNN and DeepSHAP compared with SVM, LDA, KNN, RF and decision tree under participant LOSO. A label-informed cluster-permutation mask was computed on the complete cohort before the LOSO folds; z-score normalization was fitted within training folds.
sources.датасет: Secondary analysis of Tiemann et al. 2018 Nature Communications 9:4487, DOI 10.1038/s41467-018-06875-x: motor-condition EEG from 50 of the source study's 51 healthy right-handed adults; low/high laser stimuli, 20 planned trials per intensity and participant.
sources.производительность: Authors report mean participant-LOSO accuracy 95.85% +/- 5% on the selected 50-person cohort. Results section also reports 231 high and 152 low correct plus 9 and 8 errors over 400 test trials; that pooled confusion count gives 383/400 = 95.75%. The paper does not reconcile 400 reported test trials with its 50-person by 40-trial SHAP description.
sources.кросс_субъект: Participant LOSO across 50 people, but label-informed feature-mask selection used the entire cohort before folds; the authors explicitly acknowledge possible optimistic bias.
sources.ограничения: The label-informed permutation mask was selected using all subjects, including held-out subjects, before LOSO; authors acknowledge possible optimistic bias despite train-only z-scoring. The 400-trial confusion denominator is not reconciled with the 50 by 40 trial description, and its pooled accuracy differs from the reported mean. No independent external dataset, chronic clinical pain, ECAP or SCS outcome was tested. SHAP attribution is not a causal biomarker.

provenance.query_or_seed: Explainable AI for pain perception: subject-independent EEG decoding using DeepSHAP and CNNs

evidence.population: 50 healthy right-handed adults in the motor-condition EEG subset of Tiemann et al. 2018
evidence.target_label: Individually calibrated low versus high laser-stimulus intensity classes, not an independently measured chronic-pain outcome

validation.notes: Publisher version-of-record PDF (13 pages) was read through r.jina.ai text rendering because direct IOP requests returned a Radware CAPTCHA; primary source is the IOP PDF URL. Section 2.4 explicitly says a supervised permutation mask used the complete dataset before participant LOSO and acknowledges optimistic bias. Training-fold z-scoring does not remove this feature-selection leakage. Sections 3.2-3.3 give 400 test trials and a 50 x 40 trial SHAP matrix without a reconciliation. The original dataset is Tiemann et al. 2018 motor-condition EEG, not a new patient cohort.

sources.авторы: Yasamin Zarghami; Muhammad Muzammil; Vida Adeli; Hailey Reimer; Thomas Hadjistavropoulos; Babak Taati
sources.модальность: Лицевые экспрессии

sources.метод: ControlNet, diffusion
sources.датасет: UNBC-McMaster and UofR real images; UofR driver expressions transferred onto 250 generated identities; synthetic pain and neutral images augment classifier training
sources.производительность: With full real training data, synthetic augmentation did not improve pairwise PSPI detection (AUC/AP/F1) over the real-only baseline (Table 4). At 6.25% real training data, one-tailed Mann-Whitney U tests favored Real+PainControl (p=0.0037) and Real+PainControl+LivePortrait (p=0.0008) in AUC (Table 5); higher fractions were not significant.
sources.ограничения: Expression transfer uses UNBC and UofR real images. The pairwise detector uses full UNBC plus fivefold UofR/synthetic training and evaluates UofR dementia images. Authors exclude synthetic images derived from the test fold, but do not specify whether UofR folds are participant-disjoint or whether the expression-transfer model and driver pool exclude all test identities. No independent external test cohort is reported.

evidence.population: 25 real UNBC shoulder-pain participants; 47 UofR participants with severe dementia and 47 healthy older adults; 250 generated identities used for synthetic expression transfer.
evidence.target_label: AU-derived PSPI facial-expression score 0-16 and thresholded pain/non-pain detection; neither a self-report nor an SCS outcome.

validation.notes: Expression transfer uses UNBC and UofR real images. The pairwise detector uses full UNBC plus fivefold UofR/synthetic training and evaluates UofR dementia images. Authors exclude synthetic images derived from the test fold, but do not specify whether UofR folds are participant-disjoint or whether the expression-transfer model and driver pool exclude all test identities. No independent external test cohort is reported. Primary full text rechecked on 2026-09-25: evaluation includes real human source data and generated images; the target is bounded to the dataset labels, not subjective chronic pain or SCS response.

sources.название: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans
sources.авторы: König, S.; Ramadan, A.; Sullivan, D. et al.
sources.модальность: Epidural SCS ECAP waveforms recorded through two externalized percutaneous leads
sources.задача: Classify individual pulses as ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact and model waveform features across stimulation settings
sources.метод: Artifact cleaning, PCA clustering, K-nearest-neighbor classification and generalized linear mixed-effects models
sources.датасет: Eight chronic-pain participants undergoing an externalized SCS trial; two caudal contacts stimulated and remaining contacts recorded
sources.производительность: AUC separated ECAP from non-ECAP better than peak-to-peak amplitude (d'=2.44 versus 2.27); preferred polarities reduced current by about 1.25 mA
sources.кросс_субъект: no: participant variability was modeled, but no held-out-participant validation is reported
sources.ограничения: Small eight-participant observational trial. Pulse-level classification and mixed-effects modeling do not establish participant-independent prediction. ECAP is a neural-response/control signal, not a direct measurement of pain or clinical response.

sources.авторы: Aifeng Liu; Longyao Zhang; Enyan Xue; Chao Zhang; Tianci Guo; Jida Wang; Dong Ming
sources.модальность: Self-report, behavioral and functional proxies, neurophysiology, imaging, biofluids, autonomic physiology, wearables and multimodal AI
sources.задача: Clinically oriented narrative framework for selecting pain-assessment layers by task and population
sources.метод: Narrative review of PubMed, Web of Science and Embase through April 2026 with author-derived clinical-maturity synthesis
sources.датасет: Previously published reviews, consensus statements and representative studies; no new dataset or formal systematic-review corpus
sources.производительность: No pooled effect or model metric; the review explicitly requires task-specific effect size, reproducibility, external validation, interpretability and decision impact
sources.ограничения: This is a clinically oriented narrative review, not a registered systematic review or evidence grade. Author-derived maturity labels are synthesis judgments. It explicitly states that self-report, behavior, function and biosignals are related but non-interchangeable and that no universal objective pain marker exists.

sources.авторы: Sabrina Al Bukhari; Mehaboobathunnisa S. Hameed; Bart Michiels; Muhammad Kumail; Jinane Mounsef; Lars Arendt-Nielsen; Yacine Hadjiat
sources.модальность: Visual, physiological, EEG, audio and multimodal pain-assessment inputs
sources.задача: Structured narrative review of transformer- and attention-based automated pain assessment
sources.метод: PRISMA-informed narrative synthesis of studies published from 2015 through 2025
sources.датасет: 35 peer-reviewed studies spanning experimental and clinical tasks
sources.производительность: No meta-analysis; the abstract notes that some controlled binary benchmarks exceed 90% but performance often falls under LOSO, subject-independent or cross-dataset evaluation
sources.ограничения: Heterogeneous targets, datasets, modalities, metrics and validation protocols precluded quantitative pooling. Screening and extraction were performed by one reviewer and no formal protocol was registered. Reported high benchmark scores are not transferable estimates of clinical performance.

sources.модальность: ECAP amplitude, stimulation dose consistency, Likert therapy-experience ratings and patient preference
sources.задача: Compare ECAP-controlled closed-loop with open-loop SCS during activities of daily living
sources.метод: Prospective multicenter randomized single-blind crossover trial (ECHO-MAC, NCT04765735)
sources.датасет: 42 chronic-pain participants in the intent-to-treat analysis
sources.производительность: 97.6% had reduced sensation with closed-loop SCS; lower confidence limit 87.4% exceeded the 50% goal; 37/42 preferred closed loop; ECAP-amplitude SD 8.72 µV versus 19.95 µV
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: participant-level randomized crossover clinical comparison, not a prediction model
sources.ограничения: The primary endpoint is therapy sensation/experience and dose consistency, not analgesic efficacy or future-response prediction. ECAP amplitude is used as a neural activation control signal and must not be interpreted as pain intensity.

sources.название: Descending neurons integrate learnt information from mushroom body with context to promote escape behaviour
sources.авторы: Benjamin M W Jones; Samuel N Harris; Nicolo G Ceffa; Albert Cardona; Marta Zlatic
sources.модальность: Нейронная активность
sources.задача: Интеграция обучения и ноцицепции
sources.метод: Larval connectome path analysis; ex-vivo two-photon calcium imaging after optogenetic neuronal activation; separate conditioned-odor and nociceptive-proxy rolling assays
sources.датасет: Published L1 larval CNS EM connectome; separate third-instar ex-vivo imaging and behavioral preparations
sources.производительность: Ipsigoro activation increased Goro ΔF/F (Fig. 2f, N=8); MD-IV activation increased Ipsigoro ΔF/F (Fig. 3c, N=8); Ipsigoro manipulation changed rolling under thermal or MD-IV activation
sources.ограничения: bioRxiv v1, without peer review. Heating activates genetically targeted Basin or MD-IV pathways and also supplies thermal context; these manipulations are nociceptive proxies, not a direct measure of subjective pain. Imaging, EM anatomy and rolling use distinct preparations; behavioral group totals are not stated in the main PDF. No human ECAP or SCS outcome.

evidence.population: Third-instar wandering larvae in neural and behavioral assays; a separately published first-instar L1 CNS EM volume supplies the structural reference
evidence.sample_size: N=8 for each of the Goro and Ipsigoro calcium-imaging comparisons; behavioral group totals are not stated in the main PDF; eight larvae were placed per recording run
evidence.target_label: Goro and Ipsigoro calcium responses, separately from third-instar rolling escape after neural activation or inhibition

validation.notes: Author bioRxiv v1 41-page PDF retrieved and checked (SHA-256 recorded in NS-03 audit). Third-instar experimental larvae are distinct from the published L1 EM reference. Goro and Ipsigoro ΔF/F, connectome paths and rolling are separate observations; no subjective pain endpoint. Behavioral total N is unavailable in the main PDF.

sources.название: Randomized Modality Mixing with Patchwise RBF Networks for Robust Multimodal Pain Recognition
sources.авторы: Mehmet Erdal; Sascha Gruss; Steffen Walter; Friedhelm Schwenker
sources.модальность: ECG, EDA and EMG physiological features; facial video excluded
sources.задача: Robust multimodal experimental-pain recognition under limited training data
sources.метод: Randomized modality mixing plus patchwise radial-basis-function networks and ensemble aggregation
sources.датасет: X-ITE: 134 subjects, 30 selected as test subjects, 10 trials per subject; BioVid Part A: 87 recorded, 80 analyzed after seven exclusions
sources.производительность: X-ITE RBF-Patch-Net with ModMix: 87.1 ± 11.3% mean accuracy versus 86.4 ± 10.3% without augmentation; 12/30 subjects improved, 7 unchanged, 11 worsened. BioVid without augmentation: both compared models approximately 81% mean accuracy.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes: each X-ITE trial excludes the test subject from training; BioVid uses the remaining subjects as training
sources.ограничения: Experimental thermal/electrical pain classification in healthy volunteers, not clinical SCS outcomes. X-ITE uses a participant-disjoint test subject in each trial, but the 30 subjects are not one fixed independent holdout across trials. ModMix improves mean accuracy by about 0.7 percentage points and worsens 11/30 subjects. BioVid final analysis omits augmentation; no independent external validation of ModMix or patient-level prospective validation is reported. Hyperparameter grid-search selection unit is unclear.

provenance.query_or_seed: exact ModMix title author version search

evidence.population: Healthy X-ITE and BioVid participants; X-ITE 134 total/30 tested, BioVid 87 total/80 analyzed
evidence.sample_size: X-ITE 134 subjects, 30 tested; BioVid 87 recorded, 80 analyzed
evidence.target_label: Experimental pain-recognition labels in X-ITE and BioVid

validation.notes: Official publisher PDF checked (SHA-256 1805489e984deb4673e0a3c2fd236a66167331acd82df5899e0e75175088a28f). X-ITE tests 30 selected subjects with 10 participant-disjoint trials each; training uses 2500 observations from the other 133 subjects and 500 augmented training points. BioVid tests 80 analyzed subjects with 3000 observations drawn from the other subjects, five runs, and no augmentation in the final analysis. ModMix data filtering uses a network trained on original data; tuning selection and code-level fold reproduction were not established.

sources.название: Pain in 3D: Controllable Generation of Synthetic Faces for Automated Pain Assessment
sources.авторы: Xin Lei Lin; Soroush Mehraban; Abhishek Moturu; Babak Taati
sources.модальность: Synthetic 3D facial images and real facial frames
sources.задача: AU-controlled synthetic facial pain generation and visual PSPI estimation
sources.метод: FLAME mesh, diffusion texture and AU rigging; ViTPain with neutral-reference cross-attention
sources.датасет: 3DPain 82,500 frames across 2,500 synthetic identities; UNBC-McMaster 48,398 real frames from 25 participants
sources.производительность: UNBC fivefold subject-independent evaluation: ViTPain with 3DPain pretraining AUROC 0.86 at PSPI>=1 and 0.89 at PSPI>=3
sources.ограничения: Visual PSPI task with subject-disjoint UNBC fivefold evaluation and no independent second real dataset. The v5 manuscript calls UNBC reserved for evaluation, but the official implementation at the reviewed commit fine-tunes on labeled UNBC training folds after synthetic pretraining. The code resolves the executable protocol, while provenance of every reported paper result to this commit remains unverified. No physiological synthetic modality or unlabeled-target alignment as in S149.

evidence.target_label: Facial Action Units and PSPI 0-16

validation.notes: Synthetic identity-disjoint 70/20/10 and UNBC subject-disjoint fivefold splits are reported. Official author code loads real UNBC PSPI/AU labels, trains on each fold's training subjects, and evaluates held-out subjects. This resolves the available implementation's real-label role, although the v5 manuscript remains internally inconsistent and exact paper-result provenance to the reviewed commit is unverified.

sources.название: Methods and system for recording human physiological signals from implantable leads during spinal cord stimulation
sources.авторы: Ahmed Ramadan; Seth D. König; Mingming Zhang; Erika K. Ross; Alexander Herman; Théoden I. Netoff; David P. Darrow
sources.модальность: Human epidural SCS recordings and ECAP signal processing
sources.задача: Assess hardware settings and artifact-removal fits for ECAP measurement during SCS
sources.метод: Two trial patients with externalized leads; fit single exponential, double exponential and second-order polynomial to averaged recordings at 0.375-4 ms after stimulation, then subtract each fit and compare ECAP N1 timing, P2-N1 amplitude and fit computation time
sources.датасет: Two participants, 20 observations across visits and stimulation parameters; one observation is one or more concatenated trials, not an independent participant
sources.производительность: Double exponential fit gave the best artifact fit; second-order polynomial gave similar ECAP N1 timing and P2-N1 amplitude with shorter computation time in the tested recordings
sources.кросс_субъект: no: methods comparison used repeated recordings from two participants
sources.ограничения: Technical ECAP extraction from only two patients; no independent held-out-patient evaluation or clinical pain-outcome prediction. The authors caution that curve fitting may overestimate or underestimate neural response and that averaging opposite polarities can distort ECAP morphology.

sources.название: Diversity of meso-scale architecture in human and non-human connectomes
sources.авторы: Richard F. Betzel; John D. Medaglia; Danielle S. Bassett
sources.модальность: Published inter-areal structural connectomes across Drosophila, mouse, rat, macaque and human; human functional connectivity and mouse gene co-expression as separate comparisons
sources.задача: Compare assortative, core-periphery and disassortative mesoscale community organization across species
sources.метод: Weighted stochastic blockmodel fitted to inter-areal connectomes and compared with modularity maximization over K=2-10 communities, with 250 runs per K; community-interaction motifs and diversity indices were analyzed
sources.датасет: Previously published inter-areal connectomes in five species; Drosophila analysis is supplementary. The main text models group-representative human connectome data. Data availability states that study data are obtainable from authors on reasonable request.
sources.производительность: In human data, weighted stochastic-blockmodel partitions aligned more strongly with functional-connectivity within-versus-between community contrast than modularity partitions; no cross-species transfer score or ECAP/SCS metric was reported
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: descriptive cross-species graph comparison, not a participant-disjoint predictive transfer test
sources.ограничения: The Drosophila and human graphs are compared at inter-areal mesoscale, not neuron-level FlyWire/VNC resolution. Human functional-connectivity corroboration does not validate a Drosophila-to-human dynamical representation, causal invariant, ECAP operator or SCS outcome.

sources.авторы: Shin-ya Takemura; Kenneth J. Hayworth; Gary B. Huang; Michal Januszewski; Zhiyuan Lu; Elizabeth C. Marin; et al.

sources.метод: Large-volume serial EM imaging, automated segmentation and synapse identification, neuronal tracing/proofreading and neuPrint access
sources.датасет: One five-day-old male adult VNC sample, called MANC; about 23,000 traced neurons, 10 million presynaptic TBars and 74 million postsynaptic densities. Reviewed-preprint v1 identifies the neuPrint dataset as MANC without pinning an immutable database release used in S740.

sources.ограничения: The eLife article is a Reviewed Preprint v1, not an independent experimental validation of S740's model. It identifies the public neuPrint MANC dataset but not the exact export/release underlying S740's processed matrix. sources.задача: Predict sensorimotor responses in feeding and antennal grooming circuits from a whole-brain connectome model
sources.метод: Brainwide leaky integrate-and-fire model with alpha-synapse dynamics on connectome weights and predicted excitatory/inhibitory identities; sensory and interneuron activation compared with neural and behavioral experiments

sources.ограничения: The model concerns adult central-brain feeding and grooming circuits, not VNC walking or nociceptive subjective pain. Authors caution that absolute model firing rates are unreliable because morphology, receptor dynamics, gap junctions, peptides and neuromodulation are omitted. Fly experiments validate scoped circuit hypotheses, not human ECAP or SCS outcomes. Exact graph release was not found in the checked JATS article.

sources.название: Long-term safety and efficacy of closed-loop spinal cord stimulation to treat chronic back and leg pain (Evoke): a double-blind, randomised, controlled trial
sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Robert M. Levy; Timothy R. Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Corey W. Hunter; Steven M. Rosen; Shrif J. Costandi; Steven M. Falowski; Abram H. Burgher; Jason E. Pope; Christopher A. Gilmore; Farooq A. Qureshi; Peter S. Staats; James Scowcroft; Jonathan Carlson; Christopher K. Kim; Michael I. Yang; Thomas Stauss; Lawrence Poree; Evoke Study Group
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs fixed-output open-loop SCS; evoked compound action potentials, patient-reported VAS back/leg pain, and adverse events
sources.задача: Randomised double-blind comparison of ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus fixed-output open-loop spinal cord stimulation for chronic back and leg pain
sources.метод: Multicentre, double-blind, parallel-arm randomised controlled trial (1:1) at 13 US clinics; computer-generated randomisation in permuted blocks of 4 and 6 stratified by site; patients, investigators and site staff masked. The primary outcome was tested for non-inferiority (delta=10%) then superiority in the intention-to-treat population at 3 months (primary analysis) and 12 months (additional prespecified analysis) after permanent implant. Registered as NCT02924129; trial ongoing (36-month follow-up). Evidence basis for this card is the PubMed abstract only: the Elsevier full text is subscription-gated and no open-access deposit exists.
sources.датасет: 134 randomised participants (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop); intention-to-treat analysis population 125 at 3 months (62 closed-loop, 63 open-loop) and 118 at 12 months (59/59)
sources.производительность: Primary outcome (>=50% reduction in overall back and leg pain with no increase in pain medication) met in 51/62 (82.3%) closed-loop vs 38/63 (60.3%) open-loop at 3 months (difference 21.9%, 95% CI 6.6-37.3; p=0.0052) and in 49/59 (83.1%) vs 36/59 (61.0%) at 12 months (difference 22.0%, 95% CI 6.3-37.7; p=0.0060); no differences in safety profiles
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomised controlled trial, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: Publisher full text was not legally accessible during verification, so only the PubMed abstract was extracted; denominators, effect estimates and confidence intervals are abstract-level and were not cross-checked against tables or figures. The 12-month analysis is intention-to-treat and the abstract does not expose the missing-data handling. ECAP is a proxy for neural recruitment and dose, not a direct pain measurement.

sources.название: Durability of Clinical and Quality-of-Life Outcomes of Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation for Chronic Back and Leg Pain: A Secondary Analysis of the Evoke Randomized Clinical Trial
sources.авторы: Nagy Mekhail; Robert M Levy; Timothy R Deer; Leonardo Kapural; Sean Li; Kasra Amirdelfan; Corey W Hunter; Steven M Rosen; Shrif J Costandi; Steven M Falowski; Abram H Burgher; Jason E Pope; Christopher A Gilmore; Farooq A Qureshi; Peter S Staats; James Scowcroft; Tory McJunkin; Jonathan Carlson; Christopher K Kim; Michael I Yang; Thomas Stauss; Julie Pilitsis; Lawrence Poree; Dan Brounstein; Samuel Gilbert; Gerrit E Gmel; Robert Gorman; Ian Gould; Erin Hanson; Dean M Karantonis; Abeer Khurram; Angela Leitner; Dave Mugan; Milan Obradovic; Zhonghua Ouyang; John Parker; Peter Single; Nicole Soliday; Evoke Study Group
sources.модальность: ECAP-controlled closed-loop vs fixed-output open-loop SCS; device-measured neural response (ECAP) alongside VAS pain, PROMIS-29, EQ-5D-5L, ODI, POMS and opioid use
sources.задача: Prespecified 24-month durability analysis of clinical and quality-of-life outcomes in the Evoke randomised controlled trial
sources.метод: Secondary analysis of the double-blind, randomised, controlled, parallel-arm Evoke trial (NCT02924129) with 36 months of follow-up at 13 US sites; analysis performed October 2020 to April 2021. All randomised patients (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop) were included in the 24-month primary outcome analysis using last-observation-carried-forward; per-protocol completers at 24 months were 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop.
sources.датасет: 134 randomised participants (67 closed-loop, 67 open-loop); 24-month per-protocol completers 50 closed-loop and 42 open-loop
sources.производительность: At 24 months, >=50% overall pain reduction in 53/67 (79.1%) closed-loop vs 36/67 (53.7%) open-loop (difference 25.4%, 95% CI 10.0-40.8; P=.001) and >=80% reduction in 31/67 (46.3%) vs 20/67 (29.9%) (difference 16.4%, 95% CI 0.2-32.6; P=.047); no difference in safety profiles (study-related adverse event rate difference 6.0, 95% CI -7.8 to 19.7); quality-of-life, physical and emotional functioning and sleep gains paralleled opioid reduction or elimination
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: randomised controlled trial, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: Secondary analysis of an already-randomised cohort, not a new trial, so it is not independent evidence relative to the 3- and 12-month Evoke reports. The 24-month primary analysis applies last-observation-carried-forward to all randomised patients, which assumes outcomes stay stable after dropout; only 50 and 42 patients per arm completed the 24-month visit. ECAP is a proxy for neural recruitment and dose, not a direct pain measurement.

sources.задача: Compare long-term clinical and neurophysiological outcomes of ECAP-controlled and open-loop SCS at 36 months
sources.метод: Blinded randomized parallel-arm follow-up of NCT02924129; all 134 randomized patients included in the 36-month intention-to-treat pain analysis with last-value-carried-forward for missing values; crossover counted as failure in a secondary analysis
sources.датасет: Same EVOKE randomized cohort as S779 and S780: 134 randomized (67/67), 113 implanted (59/54); group outcomes analyzed at 36 months

sources.ограничения: The 36-month analysis was not prespecified. Last-value-carried-forward makes an assumption about missing outcomes. Both arms used the same device and ECAP-guided programming, limiting comparison with conventional open-loop care. This is the same NCT02924129 cohort as S779/S780, not independent replication; ECAP is a neural-feedback signal, not a direct pain measure. Patient-level data require sponsor request and are not openly downloadable.

sources.авторы: Pelin G. Özdil; Javier Arreguit; Cécile Scherrer; Felix Hurtak; Auke Ijspeert; Pavan Ramdya
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila brain/VNC connectomes, optogenetic JO-F stimulation and measured head/antenna kinematics
sources.задача: Predict bilateral versus unilateral antennal grooming coordination from a connectome-derived dynamic network
sources.метод: Leaky-integrator connectome-derived neural network with fitted cell-type parameters and motor decoders; virtual JO-F inputs were compared with experimental optogenetic kinematics
sources.датасет: Female adult fly brain (FAFB) FlyWire materialization snapshot 783 for the grooming network; MANC v1.2.1 is used only for supplementary VNC figures. Optogenetically stimulated head/antenna kinematics came from 10 female adult training flies.
sources.производительность: Model outputs were evaluated against a held-out test kinematic dataset; this is a fly behavior comparison, not an independent human or pain-outcome test
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: fly circuit model and experiments, no human participant prediction
sources.ограничения: The fitted network is specific to antennal grooming. Foreleg amputation simplified the training assay. Model fit does not establish nociception, subjective pain, human ECAP or SCS response. The MANC v1.2.1 reference is for a supplementary VNC analysis in this paper, not the source release of S740 matrices.

sources.авторы: Gerrit Eduard Gmel; Rosana Santos Escapa; John L Parker; Dave Mugan; Adnan Al-Kaisy; Stefano Palmisani
sources.модальность: Human epidural ECAP and reported stimulation sensation
sources.задача: Characterize how SCS pulse frequency changes ECAP amplitude per pulse and perceived paresthesia strength
sources.метод: Within-patient frequency sweeps at fixed stimulation current and pulse width (2-455 Hz)
sources.датасет: 20 chronic-pain patients recruited; 16 patients/22 analyzable ECAP sweeps; 13 patients/18 sensation sweeps
sources.производительность: ECAP amplitude fell as frequency rose, while reported stimulation sensation increased; no pain-relief endpoint measured
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: within-subject experimental observations, no prediction model
sources.ограничения: Within-patient sweeps without independent validation; high frequencies limited by discomfort; ECAP and paresthesia are not pain intensity or clinical SCS response.

evidence.sample_size: 20 recruited; 16 patients/22 ECAP sweeps; 13 patients/18 sensation sweeps
evidence.target_label: ECAP amplitude per pulse and separately rated stimulation sensation across frequency sweeps

validation.notes: Full publisher text checked. No analgesia or future patient outcome is assessed. Repeated sweeps do not increase the patient denominator. Gmel et al. 2023 (DOI 10.3389/fnins.2023.1297814) explicitly reuses this study setup and its 20 recruited patients for a distinct postsynaptic dorsal-column analysis; do not count as independent cohorts.

sources.название: Deep domain adaptation with ordinal regression for pain assessment using weakly-labeled videos
sources.авторы: Gnana Praveen Rajasekhar; Eric Granger; Patrick Cardinal
sources.модальность: Facial video
sources.задача: Weakly supervised pain intensity estimation with cross-domain adaptation and ordinal regression
sources.метод: I3D, deep adversarial domain adaptation, multiple-instance regression, Gaussian ordinal labels, adaptive MIL pooling
sources.датасет: RECOLA fully labeled source; UNBC-McMaster weakly labeled target (25 people, 200 videos, 47,398 frames); BioVid Part A (87 people, 8,700 videos, sequence labels 0-4) additional target evaluation; private fatigue data are not pain outcomes.
sources.производительность: UNBC LOSO: 15 train, 9 validation, 1 test participant per fold. BioVid evaluation randomly holds out 20 of 87 participants. For BioVid sequence-level evaluation, proposed DA reports PCC 0.341, ICC 0.317, MAE 1.162; comparisons use separate setups.
sources.кросс_субъект: Yes. UNBC uses LOSO by participant; BioVid test uses 20 held-out participants selected from 87.
sources.ограничения: This is the ordinal-regression journal extension of the authors' FG 2020 WSDA paper, not an independent mechanism family. It uses real labeled RECOLA source data and weak pain labels in target videos; target annotation remains necessary. No synthetic pain generation or unlabeled-target-only training is shown. Video expression scores do not establish clinical pain, SCS, or ECAP validity.

RECOLA source annotations are affective arousal/valence, not pain labels; their cross-label mapping is unresolved.

sources.название: Durability of Evoked Compound Action Potential (ECAP)-Controlled, Closed-Loop Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) in a Real-World European Chronic Pain Population
sources.авторы: Harold Nijhuis; Jan-Willem Kallewaard; Johan van de Minkelis; Willem-Jan Hofsté; Lars Elzinga; Philippa Armstrong; Ismaïl Gültuna; Emre Almac; Ganesan Baranidharan; Serge Nikolic; Ashish Gulve; Jan Vesper; Birte E. Dietz; Dave Mugan; Frank J. P. M. Huygen
sources.модальность: Prospective multicenter observational real-world cohort; ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS device metrics and patient-reported pain outcomes (VNRS)
sources.задача: Describe clinical pain outcomes and electrophysiological/device metrics in routine ECAP-controlled closed-loop SCS use in European chronic-pain centers
sources.метод: Prospective non-interventional data collection in 13 European centers. Standard-care implants were followed at 3, 6, and 12 months; pain VNRS and ECAP device metrics were summarized. No randomized control group or blinding. Written informed consent was obtained for use of patient data. Dutch centers received ethics committee affirmation W17_309#17.362 and the article states formal approval was not required under WMO; German and UK registrations/reviews are reported.
sources.датасет: 148 newly implanted patients overall; baseline VNRS n=148; follow-up VNRS n=103 at 3 months, n=91 at 6 months, n=85 at 12 months. Separate stimulation-naive cohort baseline n=135, follow-up n=93/82/76. ECAP metrics had different patient denominators (n=236/230/254 across metrics), not interchangeable with the 148 new implant cohort.
sources.производительность: Overall mean VNRS 8.2 at baseline (n=148), 2.6 at 3 months (n=103), 2.7 at 6 months (n=91), 2.6 at 12 months (n=85). In stimulation-naive patients, pain relief 71% (3m) and 70% (12m); exploratory nonrandomized comparisons with AVALON/EVOKE were not statistically different. ECAP metrics: median 90% time above threshold, dose ratio 1.3, dose accuracy 4.4 uV, with denominators 236, 230, 254 respectively.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: observational outcomes study, not a predictive model
sources.ограничения: No randomized comparator, no blinding, variable follow-up and substantial missing visits (including COVID-related cancellations); denominators differ across outcomes, visits, and device metrics. Results text reports 65/85 (77%) responders at 12 months while Fig. 1 caption says 76%. The study was funded by device manufacturer Saluda Medical; several authors report financial relationships with the sponsor. Routine-care sample and center/device context limit generalization. No prospective outcome-prediction model, held-out patient split, or external validation. ECAP is neural activation/dose feedback, not a direct pain measure. Data Availability says analyzed data are included in article; no separate participant-level downloadable dataset identified.

sources.название: Canine EEG helps human: cross-species and cross-modality epileptic seizure detection via multi-space alignment
sources.авторы: Ziwei Wang; Siyang Li; Dongrui Wu
sources.модальность: Canine and human intracranial EEG; human scalp EEG
sources.задача: Cross-species and cross-modality detection of ictal versus interictal EEG trials
sources.метод: ResizeNet plus multi-space alignment of input, feature and output spaces; canine-to-human and human-to-canine transfer, with unsupervised and semi-supervised target-data scenarios
sources.датасет: Kaggle canine and human iEEG; Freiburg human iEEG; CHSZ and NICU human scalp EEG. Four heterogeneous datasets, without one combined subject denominator.
sources.производительность: Table 1: mean unsupervised MSA AUC 75.53% canine-to-human and 76.89% human-to-canine across four tasks. Tables 2-3 report semi-supervised results; the abstract's over-90% AUC refers to cases with limited labeled target data, not the unsupervised setting.
sources.кросс_субъект: Unsupervised: source-species labels only, each target subject tested separately. Semi-supervised: 5-20% labeled trials per class from the same target subject used in training; remaining trials from that subject used for testing.
sources.ограничения: Seizure detection on dog/human EEG is a methodological analogue for cross-species signal transfer. It does not use a Drosophila connectome, graph-derived causal invariant, spinal ECAP, SCS treatment, or pain outcome. Semi-supervised target-subject trial results cannot be described as subject-disjoint zero-shot transfer.

sources.название: A multilevel multimodal circuit enhances action selection in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Tomoko Ohyama; Casey M. Schneider-Mizell; Richard D. Fetter; Javier Valdes Aleman; Romain Franconville; Marta Rivera-Alba; Brett D. Mensh; Kristin M. Branson; Julie H. Simpson; James W. Truman; Albert Cardona; Marta Zlatic
sources.модальность: Thermogenetic MD IV nociceptor activation plus chordotonal vibration; GCaMP calcium imaging, electron-microscopy circuit reconstruction and larval escape behavior
sources.задача: Test how multilevel convergence of mechanosensory and nociceptive inputs shapes larval escape-mode selection
sources.метод: Behavioral multisensory assay; dTRPA1 thermogenetic activation, P2X2/ATP functional-connectivity stimulation, GCaMP6/6s imaging, optogenetics and EM reconstruction; Extended Data Fig. 8 uses a simple steady-state rate model
sources.датасет: Foraging third-instar Drosophila larvae in behavioral assays; separate wandering third-instar CNS preparations for functional imaging and early-larval specimens for EM volumes; assay-specific sample sizes, no common study-wide N
sources.производительность: Combined mechanosensory vibration (1,000 Hz, 6.7 m/s^2) and MD IV dTRPA1 activation (32 C) synergistically increase rolling versus unimodal cues; behavior is probabilistic and includes roll-fast-crawl or fast-crawl alone
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no predictive model or cross-subject evaluation
sources.ограничения: Nociceptive input is operationalized as MD IV sensory-neuron activation; the main behavioral assay substitutes thermogenetic dTRPA1 activation for a noxious sting. Outcomes are larval escape behavior and GCaMP calcium signals, not subjective pain. EM anatomy and physiology use distinct preparations/cohorts. Extended Data Fig. 8 is a simplified steady-state firing-rate toy model, not a dynamic connectome simulation. No human data, ECAP or SCS outcomes.

sources.название: Spatiotemporal Distribution of Electrically Evoked Spinal Compound Action Potentials During Spinal Cord Stimulation
sources.авторы: Jonathan S Calvert; Radu Darie; Samuel R Parker; Elias Shaaya; Sohail Syed; Bryan L McLaughlin; Jared S Fridley; David A Borton
sources.модальность: Epidural spinal ECAP and synchronized surface EMG
sources.задача: Characterize the spatial distribution of SCS-evoked spinal ECAP and its relationship to lower-extremity motor activation
sources.метод: Chronic ovine SCS model using two 24-contact epidural arrays; randomized amplitude/frequency stimulation sweeps with synchronized ECAP and EMG recording
sources.датасет: Four sheep; recordings across 2-6 months after implantation, with session counts differing by animal. Primary author manuscript and supplementary figures reviewed; no independent cohort.
sources.производительность: Descriptive physiological findings: ECAP and EMG show spatially dependent recruitment; lateral stimulation produced preferential ipsilateral responses. No predictive model or performance metric.
sources.кросс_субъект: No held-out-animal predictive validation; repeated physiological measurements across four sheep.
sources.ограничения: Animal physiological comparator only. No human pain outcome or analgesia measurement and no FEM/axon physical ECAP forward operator. The article says ECAP-behavior relationships are difficult to evaluate in sheep and calls for future human work. No independent external validation; the publisher PDF itself was not checked in this bounded audit.

provenance.query_or_seed: PA-04 backward citation screen from S764; exact PMID 35551869 and DOI 10.1016/j.neurom.2022.03.007

evidence.population: Four sheep with epidural lumbosacral arrays; per-animal recording durations and session counts vary.
evidence.sample_size: 4 sheep
evidence.target_label: Measured spatial epidural ECAP morphology and synchronized EMG motor responses; no pain label or analgesia endpoint.

validation.notes: Primary author manuscript reviewed; abstract, Methods 2.1-2.7, Results 3.1-3.3/Figs. 1-8 and Discussion. Four sheep; dual 24-contact arrays with epidural spatial ECAP and synchronized EMG. Descriptive physiological comparison, not held-out-animal prediction. No human pain/analgesia outcome and no physical ECAP forward operator. Discussion states human spatiotemporal studies are needed and calls for future model/theory-driven experiments. Publisher PDF itself was not checked.

sources.модальность: Natural parasitoid ovipositor attack; class-IV thermogenetic activation and tetanus-toxin silencing; larval behavior
sources.задача: Test how class-IV nociceptors contribute to Drosophila larval defensive rolling during parasitoid attack
sources.метод: Video-scored wasp attacks, cuticle-penetration melanotic spots, ppk-GAL4/dTRPA1 sparse activation and class-IV TNT silencing
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster third-instar larvae and Leptopilina boulardi wasps; assay-specific groups
sources.производительность: Figure 1B summarizes 124 attacks; behavior varied with attack location and cuticle penetration. Figure 3C reports 0% nocifensive rolling with class-IV TNT silencing (N=125) versus 13% in the inactive-toxin control (N=164). These are behavioral and perturbation results, not directly recorded neural activity.
sources.ограничения: Attack counts are not unique larvae; 20% of attacks involved repeated attacks on one larva. Penetration/behavior associations do not prove a direct neural response or subjective pain. No connectome dynamics, human ECAP, SCS, or clinical outcome.

sources.название: Cross-modal modulation gates nociceptive inputs in Drosophila
sources.авторы: Geng Pan; Ruonan Li; Guozhong Xu; Shijun Weng; Xiong-li Yang; Limin Yang; Bing Ye
sources.модальность: Thermal heat-plate and optogenetic C4da nociceptor stimulation; gentle mechanical touch and Cho mechanosensory modulation; separate larval neural-activity and behavior assays
sources.задача: Test how low-threshold mechanosensory input gates weak nociceptive input at the larval second-order neuron A08n and changes protective escape behavior
sources.метод: Separate assays: heat-plate behavior at 27.5/39°C with optogenetic Cho inhibition; C4da ChR2 activation with 470-nm light and Cho GtACR1 inhibition with 617-nm light; whole-cell patch clamp of second-order neurons in opened/pinned larval preparations retaining PNS and CNS; Cho-terminal GCaMP6f imaging; intact-larva rolling and dry-hard-agar crawling assays
sources.датасет: Drosophila melanogaster larval experimental cohorts. Behavioral assays, opened/pinned electrophysiology preparations, and calcium-imaging preparations are separate assay readouts; the paper does not report a pooled study-wide animal count or animal-level cross-assay linkage.
sources.производительность: Stimulus and modulation: gentle touch (10–16 mN in Fig. 1E; 10 mN in Fig. 2A) was paired with optogenetic C4da nociceptor activation (470 nm; Fig. 2A uses 50 ms, 0.40–8.89 µW/mm²); Cho activity was separately manipulated with GtACR1 or P2X2. Neural readout: whole-cell recordings show touch suppresses the number of A08n spikelets during weak C4da activation (0.40–1.04 µW/mm²) but not stronger activation; these are recorded spike-like depolarizations termed spikelets, not asserted action potentials. Touch enhanced Basin-4/Wave depolarization in Fig. 1E. Cho-terminal GCaMP6f imaging in Fig. S1A-B confirms touch activates Cho neurons. Behavior: Cho inhibition increased heat-evoked rolling at 27.5°C but not 39°C (Fig. 1A), increased C4da-evoked rolling and shifted its stimulus-response curve (Fig. 1B-C), while a separate dry-hard-agar assay found increased nociceptor-elicited crawling speed during the first second (Fig. 4C-D). Fig. 1C reports groups of 56–116 larvae per intensity point; other sample sizes are panel-specific.
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: animal behavioral and physiological study; no participant-level predictive model
sources.ограничения: The article combines separate behavior, electrophysiology, and calcium-imaging assays; it does not establish that all readouts came from the same animals. A08n responses are electrophysiological spikelets/depolarizations in opened, pinned larval preparations with intact PNS/CNS; Cho calcium imaging measures mechanosensory Cho activity, not C4da nociceptor calcium. Optogenetic C4da activation is distinct from mechanical touch, and rolling/crawling are distinct behavioral endpoints. Assay-specific sample sizes are reported rather than a pooled study-wide N. The study measures nociceptive processing and protective behavior; it does not measure subjective pain, human ECAP, SCS, or clinical outcomes.

производительность.value: Stimulus and modulation: gentle touch (10–16 mN in Fig. 1E; 10 mN in Fig. 2A) was paired with optogenetic C4da nociceptor activation (470 nm; Fig. 2A uses 50 ms, 0.40–8.89 µW/mm²); Cho activity was separately manipulated with GtACR1 or P2X2. Neural readout: whole-cell recordings show touch suppresses the number of A08n spikelets during weak C4da activation (0.40–1.04 µW/mm²) but not stronger activation; these are recorded spike-like depolarizations termed spikelets, not asserted action potentials. Touch enhanced Basin-4/Wave depolarization in Fig. 1E. Cho-terminal GCaMP6f imaging in Fig. S1A-B confirms touch activates Cho neurons. Behavior: Cho inhibition increased heat-evoked rolling at 27.5°C but not 39°C (Fig. 1A), increased C4da-evoked rolling and shifted its stimulus-response curve (Fig. 1B-C), while a separate dry-hard-agar assay found increased nociceptor-elicited crawling speed during the first second (Fig. 4C-D). Fig. 1C reports groups of 56–116 larvae per intensity point; other sample sizes are panel-specific.

sources.производительность: Behavior: 46 C probe measured latency to a completed 360-degree nocifensive escape roll (NEL; stimulation cutoff 11 s); 39 C probe used for hypersensitivity; optogenetic ChR2 assays used 3.8 klux or 76 klux in the 24-hour induction arm. These are separate animal preparations/readouts. pMad staining reports BMP pathway activation and is not neural activity.

sources.модальность: Prospective registry data; clinical pain outcome; predictive modeling
sources.задача: Predict six-month SCS responder status from patient baseline characteristics in the Product Surveillance Registry.
sources.метод: Prospective Product Surveillance Registry cohort. Responder: reduction of at least 2 points on a 0-10 pain score at six months versus baseline. Poster reports an 80/20 training/test split, five repeated five-fold cross-validation on the training set, and penalized logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. The abstract/poster do not establish patient-level split implementation, the final model-specific denominator, linkage details, or external-cohort validation.
sources.датасет: Medtronic Product Surveillance Registry; 721 back and/or leg pain patients enrolled August 2012 through October 2023 were included in the analysis. Individual-level dataset access is not established.
sources.производительность: The poster describes random forest as relatively better on sensitivity and F1 score. Exact metric values were not independently transcribed. No external validation cohort is reported in the checked abstract/poster.
sources.ограничения: Conference abstract and poster only. The poster prose says 274/363 combined-pain patients responded; its Table 1 instead lists 267 responders and 96 nonresponders (total 363), and the publisher abstract also says 267/363 (74%). Preserve the discrepancy; do not treat 274 as confirmed. Publisher page currently returns 403 to direct fetch. No full methods, patient-level data/linkage, exact split unit, or external validation were established. This is a clinical outcome prediction study; no ECAP predictor or neural recording is stated.

evidence.target_label: At least 2-point reduction on a 0-10 pain score at six months versus baseline. Subgroup count for combined back-and-leg-pain responders conflicts: publisher abstract and poster Table 1 say 267/363; poster prose says 274/363.

validation.notes: Primary publisher abstract and Medtronic/NANS author poster checked. Publisher abstract and poster Table 1 report 267/363 combined back-and-leg-pain responders (74%); poster prose says 274/363. Poster Table 1 also lists 96 nonresponders, summing with 267 to 363. Discrepancy retained without correction. Dataset includes 721 registry patients. No full methods or patient-level data were available; the abstract/poster do not specify patient-level split assignment or external validation. No ECAP predictor is stated.
